text_block_list.text: Facilities not found at Tracen Academy.

Facilities not found even in full-fledged 
training centers in Hokkaido.

Yet without it, Jungle Pocket will not 
make a proper recovery. In that case—
choice_data_list: We just have to find it. No matter what!

text_block_list.text:
There's a chance it doesn't exist 
domestically. The odds of finding it are 
minuscule.

Yet if there is one, where could it be? 
The key must be...
choice_data_list:
It's "passion." And an intense one at 
that.

text_block_list.text:
A facility determined to make Umamusume 
run no matter how fragile their legs are. 
Or perhaps...

Is there a place somewhere... where 
someone holds such a wish?
Close your eyes... and think.

"Someday... I feel like I heard a voice 
like that once. If I recall... a long time 
ago..."

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
She's strong, isn't she? She has the 
caliber to stand at the very top of her 
generation. Even the Derby, surely...! 
I've got to give her my full support, too.

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
…………It's my fault. I couldn't prevent her 
injury. I'm the one who crushed Fuji 
Kiseki's future...!

Big Bro felt that way. Naturally, though, 
Big Bro currently had no such facilities 
available...

However, the place where my brother works 
is—

A super-scale medical center. Or perhaps a 
rehabilitation center.

A place dedicated to the revitalization of 
Umamusume, conducting research and 
providing support day and night. If 
anywhere, the answer might be there.

After searching desperately for potential 
candidates...

I stumbled upon a familiar name. The 
location was—Hokkaido.
Just maybe...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you. I know that facility. I'm 
acquainted with the staff there as well.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
The owner is a major industrialist, you 
see. As part of that business, they even 
built a facility up in Hokkaido.
choice_data_list:
Could you connect me with them? I'd like 
to hear their story.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text: —Understood. Let's connect it.

And so, things progressed, and the time 
finally came to visit that place together 
with Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm, this company name...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ââ!! Trainer, this place is...

I give a small nod. Even Jungle Pocket 
seems to have picked up on it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Damn, this blows Tracen Academy out of the 
water. They've got freakin' everything 
here.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's over there is... an ultra-large 
high-speed treadmill, huh. And the one 
beyond that is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's like a research lab. Why is there a 
facility like this here...?
Why, you ask? Isn't it obvious?

It's so as many Umamusume as possible who 
had their dreams stolen can take them 
back.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You're... I knew it!
Welcome, Jungle Pocket. Or rather...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Pokke! Hahaha, getting injured 
isn't like you at all, is it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tsuzuki...!! Oooooh, Tsuzuki...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Why you little, acting all high and 
mighty!! You jerk!!

"Tsuzuki Restart Support Center." Yes, 
this is—

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
It's one of the Tsuzuki Group's 
facilities. People usually call it 
'Tsuzusen.' That's where I currently work.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
This is a second career granted by a lucky 
escape. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"I decided to throw myself into a venture 
to which I can dedicate my entire being at 
full power."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, my father was looking to 
expand from his main construction business 
into supporting Umamusume. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
They let me join in as a member. 
Naturally, to make it a business success 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, training with you saved this life 
of mine...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to give it back. —To 
reclaim the future.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tsuzuki...!

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, feel free to use the facilities 
as you wish. If needed, I can even arrange 
to introduce them to Tracen Academy later. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
For now, please just push through by using 
both this place and the Tracen Academy 
facilities together.
(Whirrrr!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There's no weird strain at all. I can kick 
straight forward. And what's more...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The angle can be adjusted freely, too. 
With this...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, I can do it! I can totally do 
this! How long has it been since I could 
run without a single care in the world?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Watch my run—see me ROAAAR!!

Jungle Pocket's seemingly hopeless 
situation completely turned around.

As long as recovery gets on track, the 
condition of the leg will improve day by 
day.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, let's go, let's go, let's go, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I can just run as I please, then I...!! 
UOOOOOHHHH!!
And time passed—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Tsuzuki. Seriously, thanks for 
everything. Though I'm not sure if I was 
much help to you...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"You without a doubt helped me out. I 
will—repay this favor, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Heh, gratitude? In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
Show me you can win the Arima Kinen. That 
grand showdown where so many Umamusume 
gather.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah—I'll win. But just that won't be 
enough to repay you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it some proper thought later. 
See ya around, then.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
—While waiting for the return flight.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, partner. You were the best this 
time—seriously, the absolute best..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You seriously saved my racing career. 
Without you, that would've been the end 
for me.
choice_data_list: No, I only did what anyone would do.
No, I only did what anyone would do.

text_block_list.text:
Her deep bond of friendship with Jungle 
Pocket and the frustration handed down 
from big brother became her lifeline.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back. That takes care of our 
preparations. They're waiting for us with 
bated breath over there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"A bunch of reckless daredevils looking to 
beat the crap outta me and become the 
strongest, that's who!"
